newsitem.title: USA: Seagull to meet Moodys,S&P next week.
newsitem.headline: Seagull to meet Moodys,S&P next week.

text.p: Segaull Energy Corp plans to meet with credit rating agencies Moodys and Standard & Poor's next week in an effort to win a credit rating upgrade, chairman Barry Galt told a conference here.

"We are hanging on the lip of investment grade and will be sorely disappointed if we do not come out with one or both of them," Galt told the Independent Petroleum Association of America conference here on Wednesday.
Seagull is rated BB-plus by S&P and Ba2 by Moodys. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
